citation.title: A stochastic gradient online learning and prediction method for accelerating structural topology optimization using recurrent neural network
citation.venue: Engineering Structures 338 (September 2025) 120507 (Crossref). Hybrid open access: Crossref lists a CC BY 4.0 licence for the version of record; OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar list the ScienceDirect page as the only open copy
citation.version_coded: none; only the abstract was read (pool record, from OpenAlex)

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no full text). The abstract claims that SGoLap, a one-hidden-layer recurrent network that learns first- and approximated second-order derivative information online and skips FE and sensitivity steps, saves up to 99.3% (2D) and 90.9% (3D) of total computing time.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded (no full text). The abstract's savings of up to 99.3% (2D) and 90.9% (3D) of total time correspond to about 143x and 11x [derived as 1 / (1 - saving); not checked against the article]. The abstract does not name the reference run; the same topology optimization without SGoLap is likely [inferred].
